Starting at 12:00 UTC, elevated errors caused 120 requests to fail. Service recovered at 12:14 UTC after we rolled back deployment D42. We know the issue began after that deployment, but its root cause has not been established, and potential data loss has not yet been assessed. Our next step is to review deployment and service logs to identify the cause and verify data integrity.

Incident notes
12:00 UTC: elevated errors began after deployment D42.
12:14 UTC: service recovered after rollback.
120 requests failed during the interruption.
Root cause: not yet established.
Data loss: not yet assessed.
